record_scope_reconstruction: Brief trucker obstruction of access at Bagratashen–Sadakhlo road crossing. Authority permitted protest and distinguished it from obstruction of customs processing; vehicle categories and direction are incomplete.

source_checks.finding: Customs spokesperson names pair, reports two-to-three hours from midnight and current opening; protests not intended to obstruct customs-house operations.
Earlier newspaper-based report includes planned Georgian-truck targeting; later official scoped report controls interpretation.

sites.name: Bagratashen–Sadakhlo road crossing
sites.coordinate_method: Arithmetic mean of mapped OSM way vertices from fresh XML, approximate crossing-area marker (not survey centroid): way/1091297664
sites.precision: Crossing/access-area reference, approximately 700 m; exact 2018 truck-blockade footprint not established.
sites.evidence_note: Explicitly named international highway bridge between Armenian control area and named Sadakhlo controls; identifies crossing pair, not Sadakhlo railway station. Current bridge representation is not evidence that this structure existed or carried the 2018 protest.
